data.name: MOD001Title
data.value: CQS request type must be internal

data.name: MOD001MessageFormat
data.value: '{0}' implements ICommand/IQuery and must be declared 'internal', not 'public'

data.name: MOD001Description
data.value: Commands and queries are module-internal wiring; only .Contracts types cross the module boundary.

data.name: MOD002MessageFormat
data.value: '{0}' references '{1}' from module '{2}' directly; reference '{2}.Contracts' instead

data.name: MOD002Description
data.value: Modules may only depend on another module's .Contracts assembly, never its implementation assembly.

data.name: MOD003MessageFormat
data.value: '{0}' derives from Aggregate/BaseEntity and must be declared 'internal', not 'public'

data.name: MOD003Description
data.value: Domain entities are module-internal; expose data across the boundary via .Contracts DTOs.

data.name: MOD004Title
data.value: MVC controllers are not allowed in modules

data.name: MOD004MessageFormat
data.value: '{0}' derives from an MVC controller base type; modules expose endpoints only via IUseCase minimal APIs

data.name: MOD004Description
data.value: Modules use IUseCase minimal-API endpoints exclusively; MVC controllers are forbidden.

data.name: MOD005Title
data.value: Public member must not expose a domain entity

data.name: MOD005MessageFormat
data.value: '{0}' exposes domain entity type '{1}' through a public signature; return/accept a .Contracts DTO instead

data.name: MOD005Description
data.value: Domain entities must never appear in a public parameter or return type, including across module boundaries.

data.name: CQS001Title
data.value: CQS handler must be internal sealed

data.name: CQS001MessageFormat
data.value: '{0}' implements IAppCommandHandler/IAppQueryHandler and must be declared 'internal sealed'

data.name: CQS001Description
data.value: CQS handlers are resolved only through DI and dispatched via ISender; they must stay internal and sealed.
